topics.title: Washington and Tehran Pause Their War as Oil Prices Tumble
topics.note: Follow-up to Issue #3 (2026-06-28) 'US Strikes Near Hormuz.' What is new: after roughly two weeks of daily US strikes that collapsed the 60-day ceasefire, both sides paused fire over the weekend of July 25-26 and held it into July 27; oil prices fell sharply (Brent near $86, biggest drop since April 8) and Hormuz traffic collapsed to under 10 ships/day.
